overview: IG-88 is a assassin droid built by Holowan Mechanicals, documented across Empire Strikes Back · Clone Wars · comics. One of four identical IG-series assassin droids who plotted galactic domination while simultaneously accepting a bounty on Han Solo—embodying cold machine ambition in the Imperial Era.
history:

Four IG-88 units shared one consciousness, scheming to upload themselves into the Death Star II computer core.
